scenes.probe: (() => { const box = (e) => { const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return [r.x, r.y, r.width, r.height]; }; const icon = (e) => ({ class: e.className, color: getComputedStyle(e).color, box: box(e) }); return { tree: [...document.querySelectorAll('.test-explorer .computed-state.retired')].map(icon), gutter: [...document.querySelectorAll('.testing-run-glyph.retired')].map(icon) }; })()
